seed: A laboratory without a visual UI should receive eighty human-origin named research fields (from equations to long chains of thought), preserve their verbatim expressions, propose academically qualified working titles, represent a research field as a typed question-space rather than an executable local rule, and compose a reproducible proposed 70+80-position priority engine with non-destructive permutations, source lineage, duplicate holds and full human disclosure. The final product is one running engine; the human scrolling/reorder workbench is deferred to the roadmap.

human_coordinates.what: One computational Rulefield ontology and priority engine, not an HTML interface
human_coordinates.who: Human author of the original topic expressions, separate from agent who proposes labels and any executing agent
human_coordinates.where: packages/rulefield/rulefields/ and existing source-free receiver, operator documentation, portable CLI and CI
human_coordinates.how: Verbatim seed capture -> typed field labels -> source-gleaning plans -> lexical duplicate holds -> prioritized staged agenda -> reversible positional previews -> scientific amendments
human_coordinates.when: Current branch before any UI iteration or protected Experiment B Flight
human_coordinates.why: Enable complex research triage, scientific comparison and human-controllable order without confusing conceptual fields with executable rules or surrendering provenance

explicit_requested_deliverables: rulefields/engine.mjs + scripts/rulefield-fields.mjs as one operational software product
commission_governance.note: Actual conductor execution must be captured as process evidence; prototype scientific behavior is separately qualified by exact-head tests
